name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

files.content:
Class form

The <dialog> element is the box. Open it with command="show-modal". It closes with Escape, a click outside (closedby="any"), or a button with command="close".

Are you absolutely sure?

This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account and remove your data from our servers.

Data-attribute form

Same dialog, no classes.

Are you absolutely sure?

This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account and remove your data from our servers.

With a form

A <form method="dialog"> closes the dialog on submit, with no script. Focus starts on the field marked autofocus.

Edit profile

Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you are done.

Custom close button

No corner button; a secondary button in the footer closes it.

Share link

Anyone who has this link will be able to view this.

Must choose (no light dismiss)

Without closedby="any" a click outside does nothing. Escape still closes it.

Delete project?

This project and all of its files will be deleted. You can not undo this.

Scrollable content and sticky footer

Terms of service

Scroll to read all of it. The actions stay in view.

By using this service, you agree to the terms described below. Please read them carefully before you continue.

You are responsible for keeping your account details safe, and for everything that happens under your account.

We may update these terms from time to time. When we do, we will let you know by email or inside the app.

You may stop using the service at any time. We may suspend accounts that break these terms.

If you have questions about these terms, contact our support team and we will be happy to help.

Custom variables

Wider, with a smaller radius, set on the <dialog>. The overlay variables work here too, because the backdrop reads them from its dialog.

Wide dialog

A max width of 32rem, a smaller radius and a darker overlay without blur.

Opening with the JavaScript API

Browsers without invoker commands need showModal() and close(). A one-line handler is enough.

Opened from script

The same dialog, opened with showModal() instead of an invoker command.

Page scroll lock

This page is taller than the window on purpose. While a dialog is open the page behind it does not scroll.
